title: Paperclip project manifest
description: What /grill writes to .paperclip/project.manifest.json and what bin/scaffold.sh reads. Only what changes the generated tree is structured; everything else the interview learned goes under `answers`.

slug.description: kebab-case product id: package names, cookie prefix default, scheme default, db name default (__PRODUCT_SLUG__)

name.description: Human name shown in app chrome, docs and README (__PRODUCT_NAME__)

scope.description: npm scope without the @ — workspaces are @<scope>/e2e, @<scope>/db (__SCOPE__)

domain.description: Production host name, e.g. app.acme.com (__DOMAIN__); default <slug>.example.com

cookiePrefix.description: Prefix for every cookie the product sets (__COOKIE_PREFIX__); default = slug

bundleId.description: iOS bundle id / Android application id (__BUNDLE_ID__); default com.<scope>.<slug without dashes>

scheme.description: Deep-link URL scheme for the mobile app (__SCHEME__); default = slug

trunk.description: Trunk branch that feature branches are cut from (__TRUNK__); default development

dbName.description: Local database name (__DB_NAME__); default = slug with dashes replaced by underscores

surfaces.description: Client surfaces to generate. The server and the shared layers are always generated.

modules.description: Module ids from skeleton/modules/<id>, in any order; the scaffold resolves `requires` and orders them.

placeholders.description: Values for the extra placeholders a selected module declares in its module.json `placeholders` (key = the __NAME__ token).

answers.description: The grill's free-form record of every confirmed answer. Read by Claude after the scaffold; never by the scaffold itself. Keys below are the conventional ones; any other key is allowed.

users.description: Who the user is and the word the product uses for them

dayOne.description: What the user does on day 1 / every day

designSource.description: Named design source of truth (Figma, prototype, none) and whether it wins on style/copy

surfacesNote.description: Mobile-first vs web-first, one-platform features on purpose

repo.description: Standalone vs monorepo, existing shared packages, the sanctioned seam

data.description: ORM/DB, own vs shared database, PHI/PII, retention

payments.description: None / Stripe web / store / both; trial policy; who decides access

llm.description: None / one provider / multi-provider; streaming; structured output; what may leave the building

analytics.description: Event store, the first funnel, the PHI contract

hosting.description: Where it deploys, CI shape, secrets location, paid build steps

team.description: Solo vs lanes, how many developers, lane split

tickets.description: Ticketing system and project key used in branch names

languages.description: Language of code/git/tickets and of product docs

naming.description: Anything about naming that is not already in `product`

workingStyle.description: Confirmed working-style defaults and deviations; roles to pre-seed

version.description: Kit version the manifest was written against (the kit's VERSION file)
